title: Valid GitHub Actions context for governed generated refresh apply

phases.objective: Allow GitHub to parse and dispatch the registered generated-artifact writer by removing the unavailable jobs-level runner.temp expression while preserving exact-head mutation controls and canonical evidence.

e2e_journeys.actor: trusted generated-artifact dispatcher and registered maintenance writer
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: workflow_dispatch with a governed work branch, exact current SHA, and APPLY_GENERATED_ARTIFACT_REFRESH confirmation
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: GitHub accepts the registered writer dispatch, the writer uses one stable evidence directory, rejects protected or stale targets, commits only allowlisted generated files by normal fast-forward, uploads canonical evidence, and requests exact-head read-only verification.
steps: Reject jobs-level use of the runner context before a runner exists.
Use one stable repository-relative output directory across apply, verification dispatch, artifact upload, and summary rendering.
Validate target_ref, expected_head_sha, typed confirmation, and protected-branch rejection before checkout.
Checkout the exact expected head and run the registered generated-artifact refresh tool.
Verify the resulting remote head and dispatch read-only PR Generated Artifact Refresh on that exact result.
Upload the governed apply report and bounded verification-dispatch evidence.
assertions: The workflow remains workflow_dispatch-only with actions:write and contents:write.
main and Production are rejected before checkout or mutation.
The exact SHA and typed confirmation remain mandatory.
The registered maintenance tool allowlist, normal fast-forward push, canonical report, and read-only verification dispatch remain unchanged.
No force push, provider call, credential disclosure, migration, deployment, or Production mutation occurs.

phases.objective: Observe one exact-head writer dispatch accepted from the trusted dispatcher and followed by canonical apply and read-only verification evidence.
Exercise malformed inputs, stale heads, protected targets, concurrent branch movement, no-op generation, write-set violations, dispatch rejection, and verification failure without Job-log authority.
This repository maintenance repair performs no live provider or deployment canary.
The writer rejects protected branches and grants no deployment, migration, provider, or Production authority.
